c: 几周前价值30美分的1杯米如今卖到了1美元。

t: She told the court she would give a full explanation of the prosecution's decision on Monday.
c: 她告诉法庭她将在星期一就控方的决定做出详尽的解释。

t: The guards have orders to shoot intruders on sight (= shoot them as soon as they see them ) .
c: 卫兵们奉命一见到有人闯入就开枪。

t: The beautiful beaches are the island's main attraction (= most popular place, activity etc ) .
c: 美丽的海滩是这个岛上的主要魅力所在。

t: Representatives from over 100 countries attended the International Peace Conference in Geneva.
c: 来自一百多个国家的代表出席了在日内瓦举行的国际和平大会。

t: Her lawyer said she understood the consequences of her actions and was prepared to go to jail.
c: 她的律师说她明白自己行为的后果并准备去坐牢。

t: There were no secretaries available to take dictation (= write down what someone is saying ) .
c: 身边没有秘书记录口授内容。

t: The storm got worse and worse. Finally, I was obliged to abandon the car and continue on foot.
c: 暴风雨越来越猛烈。最终，我被迫弃车徒步前行。

t: But while our screens are brittle, theirs is flexible--at what they say is one tenth the price.
c: 但我们的屏幕都很脆弱，他们的却很柔软，而且价钱是我们的十分之一。

t: The restaurant was full of coach parties (= groups of people travelling together on a coach ) .
c: 这家饭店里用餐的全是乘长途公共汽车的旅游团。

t: And I prefer to an ampere meter being made of aluminum even though it has analog to another one.
c: 我还想要一个铝制的安培表，虽然它与另一个类似。

t: Fears of renewed terrorist attacks cast a cloud over the event (= spoilt the happy situation ) .
c: 对恐怖分子再次发动袭击的担心给这次活动蒙上了一层阴影。

t: The "gurkophone" is one of their classics, made from a hollowed cucumber, a pepper and a carrot.
c: 黄瓜管"是他们的经典乐器之一,那是用掏空的黄瓜、辣椒和胡萝卜做的。

t: I send out Valentine's cards with the girls' photo, instead of trying to mail cards in December.
c: --我寄出有女孩子照片的情人节贺卡，以代替试图在十二月寄出的贺卡。

t: The program takes up 2.5 megabytes of disk space and can be run on a standard personal computer.
c: 这个程序占用2.5 兆字节的磁盘空间，可以在标准个人电脑上运行。

t: I was sitting on the floor shivering with fear because a bullet had been fired through a window.
c: 我坐在地板上吓得浑身发抖，因为有一颗子弹射穿窗户打了进来。

t: So this is moles per liter per second, right? It's disappearance of some concentration for time.
c: 所以这里的单位是摩尔每升每秒，对吗？这代表浓度随着时间的减少。

t: The president is to put forward new proposals for resolving the country's constitutional crisis.
c: 总统将提出解决国家宪法危机的新议案。

t: I think we can safely assume (= it is almost certain ) that interest rates will go up again soon.
c: 我想我们几乎可以肯定，利率很快会再次上调。

t: I dread to think what the carbon footprint must be like of moving that coal but we have no choice.
c: 我都不敢想象为了运这些煤产生了多少碳足迹，但我们没有选择。

t: They understood that our power alone cannot protect us, nor does it entitle us to do as we please.
c: 他们懂得单凭实力无法保护我们的安全，实力也并不赋予我们随心所欲的权利。

t: 13 people were summarily executed (= killed without any trial or legal process ) by the guerrillas.
c: 有13人被游击队员就地处决。

t: He is old and unpopular. Furthermore, he has at best only two years of political life ahead of him.
c: 他年纪已老，又不得人心，而且他最多也只有两年的政治生命了。

t: You have the choice of night fishing in the Mediterranean, or windsurfing on a lake in Switzerland.
c: 你可选择在地中海夜间垂钓，或是在瑞士的湖上玩帆板。

t: The first letter she wrote me was less than a page long, and her second letter was similarly brief.
c: 她写给我的第一封信不到一页，第二封信也一样简短。

t: For each approximate solution of a parameterized problem, the app also displays the margin of error.
c: 对于每一个参数化问题的近似结果，这个程序也会显示误差的边界。

t: Reporters asked him to clarify his position (= say exactly what his beliefs are ) on welfare reform.
c: 记者们要求他阐明他在福利改革问题上的立场。

t: Motor-racing has largely been a male preserve (= something that only men have been involved with ) .
c: 赛车基本上是男人的专利。

t: Her paintings invite comparison with those of the early Impressionists (= they remind you of them ) .
c: 她的画作让人想起早期的印象派作品。

t: Scientists have many theories about how the universe first came into existence (= started to exist ).
c: 关于宇宙的起源，科学家有多种理论。

t: Cook the sauce over a medium heat until it thickens. Meanwhile start boiling the water for the pasta.
c: 用中火把调味汁煮到变稠，同时烧水准备煮意大利面。

t: Therefore, we should be more like a miner to stand in reality, excavate off wastes, and get gold mines.
c: 所以我们更应该像一个矿工一样为执著于现实，挖开渣滓，淘出金矿。

t: There is nothing in the rules of grammar to suggest that ending a sentence with a preposition is wrong.
c: 在语法规则中没有哪一条表明以介词结束一个句子是错误的。

t: Most of the evidence was destroyed in the fire. Thus it would be almost impossible to prove him guilty.
c: 大多数证据已在大火中烧毁，因而要证明他有罪几乎是不可能的。

t: We could not reason out which way the robbers escaped, because we were unable to find any trace of them.
c: 我们推断不出这些强盗是从哪个方向逃走的，因为我们找不到他们的任何踪迹。

t: a country where drought and famines have killed up to two million people during the last eighteen years.
c: ...过去18年来干旱和饥荒致死达两百万人的一个国家。

t: He didn't look the sort of man to forgive and forget (= forgive someone and no longer think about it ) .
c: 他看上去不是那种不记仇的人。

t: the traditional division of labour (= the way that particular tasks are shared ) between husband and wife
c: 夫妻之间传统的分工

t: The professor stands accused of (= has been accused of ) stealing his student's ideas and publishing them.
c: 那位教授被指控剽窃学生的观点拿去发表。

t: They threw down the challenge that he couldn't wash 40 cars in one hour (= invited him to try to do it ) .
c: 他们激将他，说他不可能在1小时内擦洗40辆汽车。

t: The official report into the accident says that it was caused by pilot error (= a mistake by the pilot ) .
c: 那宗事故的官方报告称事故是由飞行员失误造成的。

t: Bruce spends most evenings surfing the Net (= looking at information in different places on the Internet ).
c: 布鲁斯晚上大多在网上浏览信息。

t: The price the meat is sold for bears no relation to (= is not connected to ) the price the farmer receives.
c: 肉的售价和农民拿到的价格无关。
